subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding inflation and how it affects the real value of money and investments over time
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares what a fixed amount of money could buy at two different simulated points in time under inflation
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an inflation rate to its effect on purchasing power over time
exercise.abstract: Student explains why money that isn't invested can actually lose value over time due to inflation

misconception_flags: believes an unchanging dollar amount always has the same real purchasing power over time

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
